```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Build production files
      run: npm run build --if-present || echo "Build failed but continuing due to fallback"

    - name: Validate build artifacts
      id: validate-build
      run: |
        find dist -type f -size +1M && echo "::error::Large file found" && exit 1
        find dist -type f -name "*.js" | xargs grep -q "console.error" && echo "::error::Error logs found in JS files" && exit 1
        echo "All build artifacts are valid"

    - name: Create release
      id: create_release
      uses: facebook/dotslash-publish-release@v2
      with:
        config: |
          {
            "files": [
              { "path": "dist/**/*", "dotSlash": true }
            ]
          }
        tag: v$(date +%Y.%m.%d-%H%M%S)

    - name: Upload release asset
      uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v2
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
        asset_path: dist/index.js
        asset_name: index.js
        asset_content_type: application/javascript

    - name: Log release information
      run: echo "Release created at ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.release_html_url }}"
```
